changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla alerts: alertas internas al instructor (intentos agotados, revisión solicitada). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría alerts_audit y el trigger alerts_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: In-app alerts for instructors (exhausted attempts, review requests)

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: alert_type
column.remarks: Alert type: topic_attempts_exhausted, final_attempts_exhausted or review_requested

column.name: path_step_id
column.remarks: Path step that triggered the alert

column.name: read_at
column.remarks: Moment the alert was read; null while unread

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE alerts ADD CONSTRAINT alerts_type_ck CHECK (alert_type IN ('topic_attempts_exhausted', 'final_attempts_exhausted', 'review_requested'))
CREATE TRIGGER alerts_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON alerts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in alerts

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE alerts_audit ADD CONSTRAINT alerts_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER alerts_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON alerts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS alerts_audit_trg ON alerts
